fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions of the road.
• Mark the access point to the detached structure so responders can locate it quickly on arrival.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without obstruction.
• Trim any landscaping along the access drive that narrows the driveway width or blocks sight lines from the road.
• Keep the parking area clear enough for emergency vehicles to turn around or stage without blocking the access drive.
• Post the location of the solar panel system's emergency shutoff in a visible spot near the main electrical panel or utility area.
• Label or mark the solar panel shutoff and utility disconnect points so responders can identify them without searching.
• Clear a walkable path to the rear of the property so responders are not forced to go around the front of the structure to reach limited rear access points.
• Keep any rear gate or access point unlocked or secured with a means responders can quickly open.
• Remove any stored materials or equipment in the utility area that would block access to shutoffs or meters during an emergency.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim any shrub branches that are touching or directly against the house.
• Keep the area directly around the house clear of dead leaves, twigs, and loose plant material.
• Thin shrubs near the house so they are not touching each other or overhanging the structure.
• Separate tree canopies from nearby shrubs so there is open space between them.
• Remove dead branches from trees that hang over or near the house.
• Keep tree branches trimmed up from the ground to reduce the path from low shrubs to the tree canopy.
• Maintain clear space along all driveways so vehicles and emergency responders can pass without obstruction.
• Keep irrigated landscaping well-watered and trimmed to reduce dry or dead plant material buildup.
• Remove any piles of cut vegetation, wood, or debris that have accumulated near the house or outbuildings.
